  RootPackage
  enum Color
    Red
    Green
    Blue
  enum Shape
    Circle(Int)
    Rect(Int, Int)
    Named <named>
      w: Int
      h: Int
    WithDefault <ctor>
      d: Int = <expr>
  fun main()
    val c
      FieldAccess Red
        Var Color
    when
      Var c
      arm Red
        Call println
          StringLiteral "red"
      arm Green
        Call println
          StringLiteral "green"
      arm Blue
        Call println
          StringLiteral "blue"
    val s
      MethodCall Circle
        Var Shape
        IntLiteral 5
    when
      Var s
      arm Circle(r)
        Call println
          Var r
      arm Rect(w, h)
        Call println
          Binary Add
            Var w
            Var h
      arm Named{w, ..}
        Call println
          Var w
      arm WithDefault(d)
        Call println
          Var d
    val r
      MethodCall Rect
        Var Shape
        IntLiteral 3
        IntLiteral 4
    when
      Var r
      arm Circle(x)
        Call println
          Var x
      arm Rect(w, h)
        Call println
          Binary Add
            Var w
            Var h
      arm Named{w, ..}
        Call println
          Var w
      arm WithDefault(d)
        Call println
          Var d
    val d
      MethodCall WithDefault
        Var Shape
    when
      Var d
      arm WithDefault(x)
        Call println
          Var x
      else
        Call println
          StringLiteral "other"

      MethodCall WithDefault

      Var d2
